_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. Do not copy to experiment_decision.json until a real numeric comparison exists in experiment_loop output and a documented human review has been performed. Do not invent keep/discard/retest. experiment_loop.py loads only experiment_decision.json after a comparison and rejects invented/placeholder sources. Validate a filled copy with: python3 tools/experiment_template_validator.py experiment_decision.json
decision: TEMPLATE: replace with keep, discard, or retest
reason: TEMPLATE: replace with a short documented reason from the review, e.g. Average view duration rose 18% above the baseline with no drop in completion rate
source: TEMPLATE: replace with a documented source such as 'Human review of YouTube Studio analytics on 2026-11-20 after observation window'
notes: decision must be keep, discard, or retest. reason and source are required. source must not contain invented/assumed/placeholder/guess. primary_metric should match the comparison if present. See tools/experiment_loop.py load_decision.
